summary: Initial reports indicate a U.S. strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, while jet activity and explosions were reported over western Tehran and Ahvaz. Iran's military chief threatened further naval actions against U.S. forces. Meanwhile, Israeli forces demolished a West Bank rocket-maker's home and killed five Hamas operatives in Gaza.

Jet activity and severe explosion heard in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12466, @shin_persian/12461)
Smoke column observed over western Tehran at 0609Z. (Source: @shin_persian/12457)
Iranian armed forces chief warns U.S. to expect Iranian naval moves. (Source: @yediotnews25/138007)
IDF demolishes home of Palestinian rocket manufacturer in Ramallah area. (Source: @manniefabian/59532)
Five Hamas operatives killed in Gaza strikes, including October 7 participant. (Source: @manniefabian/59537)
Israeli warplanes heading south toward Lebanon; artillery shelling in Wadi Zibqin. (Source: @redlinkleb/53620, @redlinkleb/53549)
Iran reportedly destroys LNG tanker in Gulf; crew feared dead. (Source: @shin_persian/12464)

sections.executive_summary: Initial reports indicate a U.S. strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, while jet activity and explosions were reported over western Tehran and Ahvaz. Iran's military chief threatened further naval actions against U.S. forces. Meanwhile, Israeli forces demolished a West Bank rocket-maker's home and killed five Hamas operatives in Gaza.

points: Jet activity detected over western Tehran, Tehran Province, via delayed FromIran feed at 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/12453)
Jet activity heard in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province, with a severe explosion reported shortly after. (Source: @shin_persian/12466, @shin_persian/12461)
Smoke column observed in west of Tehran at 0609Z, indicating possible strike or accident. (Source: @shin_persian/12457)
Iranian Armed Forces Chief of Staff General Abdollahi stated Iran has pushed U.S. forces at sea and will continue, warning the U.S. to prepare for Iranian naval moves. (Source: @yediotnews25/138007)
Initial Hebrew media report claims U.S. attack on Qeshm Island, southern Iran. (Source: @yediotnews25/138019)
Quds Force Commander Ismail Qaani arrived in Baghdad to calm tensions between the Iraqi government and Kataib Hezbollah over disarmament efforts. (Source: @N12chat/235534)
Unconfirmed report alleges Iran destroyed a fully-laden LNG tanker in the Gulf with crew feared dead. (Source: @shin_persian/12464)

IDF demolished the home of Abdullah Khatib in the Ramallah area for advanced rocket production in the West Bank; Khatib was part of a terror cell captured in September 2025. (Source: @manniefabian/59532)
Israeli troops apprehended two Lebanese brothers on the outskirts of Shebaa, southern Lebanon, raiding and searching their home. (Source: @manniefabian/59533)

Five Hamas operatives killed in recent Gaza strikes: Momen Rizk al-Shandaghli (platoon commander, West Jabalia Battalion), Mohammed Jihad Omar (same battalion), Ramzi Abu Taim (cell commander, Yabna Battalion, Rafah Brigade), Hussam Saleha (platoon commander, October 7 invader), and Nashat Awad (Nukhba Force cell commander). (Source: @manniefabian/59537)
Israeli warplanes observed heading south, likely toward Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/53620)
UN ambassadors toured Israel's northern border, receiving operational briefings on threats in the northern arena (Lebanon/Syria). (Source: @N12chat/235526)
Israeli health system officials warn the country is not fully prepared for another round of conflict with Iran due to insufficient protected infrastructure. (Source: @yediotnews25/138008)
IDF demolished the home of a Palestinian who attempted to build rockets for launch from the West Bank at Israeli targets in the Ramallah area. (Source: @manniefabian/59532)
IDF investigating a car ramming incident near Tapuah Junction in the West Bank; a car accelerated toward settlers at an illegal outpost, causing two injuries. (Source: @manniefabian/59535)

Five Hamas operatives killed in Gaza strikes, including an October 7 participant; IDF states they were advancing attacks on troops and civilians in systematic violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59537)
The killed operatives included platoon and cell commanders from West Jabalia, Yabna, and Nukhba units, indicating targeted degradation of Hamas command structure. (Source: @manniefabian/59537)
Artillery shelling reported in Wadi Zibqin. (Source: @redlinkleb/53549)
Explosion reported in Zoutar al-Sharqiya. (Source: @redlinkleb/53521, @redlinkleb/53527)

Israeli warplanes heading south toward Lebanese territory. (Source: @redlinkleb/53620)
Quds Force Commander Ismail Qaani arrived in Baghdad to mediate tensions between the Iraqi government and Kataib Hezbollah amid government efforts to disarm the group. (Source: @N12chat/235534)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous reporting of a U.S. strike on Iranian territory, Iranian jet activity and explosions near key infrastructure, and explicit naval threats from Tehran indicate a significant escalation in U.S.-Iran confrontation. Israel's unprecedented demolition of a West Bank home for rocket production without fatalities signals a lowered threshold for preemptive action. The killing of senior Hamas commanders in Gaza despite ceasefire understandings suggests Israel is exploiting operational freedom to degrade Hamas leadership. Meanwhile, Iranian proxy management in Iraq (Qaani's Baghdad visit) and reported Gulf maritime aggression (LNG tanker) point to a multi-domain pressure campaign. The Bahrain sirens and emergency warnings reflect regional anxiety over potential spillover.
sections.regional_response: Greece and North Macedonia foiled an Iranian-directed assassination plot, demonstrating European intelligence cooperation against Iranian external operations. The UKMTO maritime warning and Bahraini emergency alerts show Gulf states on heightened alert for Iranian retaliation. The UN ambassador tour of Israel's northern border signals diplomatic preparation for potential escalation with Hezbollah. Israel's health system warning about unpreparedness for an Iran conflict reveals domestic vulnerability concerns. The U.S. has not officially confirmed the Qeshm strike, suggesting deliberate ambiguity to manage escalation.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 120-second delayed FromIran posts (Shin Persian) provide near-real-time OSINT on Iranian air activity but require verification. The LNG tanker claim originates from a single OSINT account (DefenceGeek) without official confirmation. The Qeshm strike report comes from a Hebrew news channel (Yediot) citing unconfirmed sources. The IDF's detailed naming of killed Hamas commanders with unit affiliations suggests precise intelligence and a messaging strategy to deter ceasefire violations. Qaani's Baghdad visit indicates Iranian concern over Iraqi government moves against Kataib Hezbollah, a key proxy. The Bahrain sirens may relate to the reported Gulf maritime incident or anticipated Iranian missile launches.
